title: Modified protocol for URA3 counter-selection in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
author: Lenny Teytelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf7njrme

steps.title: Integrate URA3 Cassette
steps.instruction: Perform a standard LiAc transformation to replace the locus of interest with the URA3 cassette.

steps.title: Confirm Initial Integration
steps.instruction: Grow the cells on CSM-Ura3 plates and confirm the integration is correct via sequencing.

steps.title: Replace URA3 with Target Sequence
steps.instruction: Perform a standard LiAc transformation to replace the URA3 cassette with the target sequence.

steps.title: Recover Cells
steps.instruction: Plate the cells onto YPD-plates for overnight growth following the heat-shock.

steps.title: Prepare for Replica Plating
steps.instruction: Transfer cells from the YPD plate to the replica-plating block velvet.

steps.title: Perform Mock Replica Plating
steps.instruction: Remove excess Ura3 by performing mock replica-plating onto YPD plates.

substeps.instruction: Press a new YPD plate against the velvet and discard the plate.
Repeat this process 4 more times (total of 5 mock-YPD replicas) to slice through layers of excess Ura3.

steps.title: Select for URA3 Loss
steps.instruction: Press a single 5-FOA plate against the velvet after the five mock-YPD replicas.

steps.title: Screen for Correct Integration
steps.instruction: Grow the colonies and use sequencing to screen for the correct integration.
